provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

data_status: Controlled exact genotype proportions scaled to100individuals per habitat. Treat equality of the model proportions as deterministic here; no finite-sample p-value is requested.
definitions: For one habitat p_A=(2*n_AA+n_AB)/(2*N),H_observed=n_AB/N,and H_HWE=2*p_A*(1-p_A). Use F_deficit=1-H_observed/H_HWE for the separately pooled table. To assess each habitat, compare its whole genotype frequency vector to[p_A^2,2*p_A*(1-p_A),(1-p_A)^2]within1e-12.
scope: A pooled heterozygote deficit can reflect mixing habitats with different allele frequencies, even if each habitat matches Hardy-Weinberg proportions. It does not alone identify within-population pedigree inbreeding, selection or assay errors.
